text: decon_epoch_regression() bridges continuous regularized deconvolution   trial-level cognitive neuroscience models five stages: Kernel Quadrature Readout: requested lag \(\tau\),       continuous deconvolved activity integrated around target event       using readout_kernel. source_model = "duration",       readout window centers trial's midpoint       \(t_i + \tau + 0.5 d_i\) expands \(\max(w_{\mathrm{src}}, d_i)\). Non-Target Event De-Mixing (demix_other_events):       Using frozen inverse operator \(\mathbf{D}_r\) forward HRF       design \(\mathbf{G}_{r,0}\), function subtracts resolution-predicted       leakage non-target events (e.g., cues motor responses) using       condition-mean operator (demix_ridge >= 0.03) 2nd-order       Tikhonov joint \((T, O)\) operator (demix_ridge < 0.03). Target Cross-Talk & Duration De-Mixing (demix_target_trials):       Inverts lag-specific target resolution matrix via 2nd-order       iterated Tikhonov operator (solve_duration_demix_operator())       per-trial effective gain restoration remove trial--trial overlap       divide regularization-induced amplitude shrinkage.       source_model = "duration", centered-subspace penalty       rank-1 baseline adjustment keep constant baseline firing rates invariant       trial duration (preventing reaction-time confounding). Optional Multi-Lag Point-Spread De-Mixing (demix_within_trial):       enabled across \(\ge 3\) lags, sharpens temporal specificity across       lags using 2nd-order Tikhonov lag--lag resolution inverse       preserving cross-trial operator covariance structure. Analytical Uncertainty, Precision Weights & Null-Mode-Damped ZCA Whitening:       Propagates observation-level AR(1) noise covariance composite       linear readout/de-mixing operator \(\mathbf{B}_{r,\tau}\) obtain exact       per-trial standard errors (se_demixed), adjacent-trial error       autocorrelation (error_ac1), Empirical-Bayes precision weights       (precision_weight), covariance-propagated sandwich SEs       (se_weighted), null-mode-damped, Bartlett-adaptive within-run       ZCA-whitened variables mixed_by.

Stage 2 (Deconvolution): Use deconvolve_crossrun_hrf       lambda = NULL (adaptive prewhitened GCV tuning),       scaling = "noise_sd" (AR(1) innovation noise SD rather       total "zscore" variance), penalty = "sobolev".
